blocks.text: Fe'l + in / into / with / to / on

«Fe'l + predlog» mavzusining so'nggi darsi. happen **to**, belong **to** qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 113-dars). Bu darsda: **believe** va **believe in** farqi, **in** va **into** farqi (holat va harakat), **provide with** kabi «kishi + with + narsa» qoliplari, **prefer ... to ...**, **spend on**. Umumiy g'oya: **in** — biror soha ichida bo'lish; **into** — harakat bilan ichiga kirish, urilish yoki bo'linish; **with** — biror narsa bilan ta'minlash, to'ldirish yoki to'qnashish; **on** — diqqat, pul yoki talabni bitta nuqtaga qaratish. O'zbekchada bularning ko'pi `-ga` bilan («devorga urildi», «uch qismga bo'ldi», «kiyimga sarfladi»), shuning uchun «to» deyish xatosi juda ko'p.
in: believe in, specialise in, succeed in

**believe** somebody / something — gapiga ishonmoq, rost deb bilmoq: I believe you. **believe in** — 1) **mavjudligiga** ishonmoq: believe **in** ghosts; 2) biror g'oyaning **to'g'riligiga, foydasiga** ishonmoq: I believe **in** hard work. **specialise in** — ... ga ixtisoslashmoq (British imlosi: -ise). **succeed in** + -ing — ... ga muvaffaq bo'lmoq («succeed to do» — xato, → 62-dars). **invest in** — ... ga sarmoya kiritmoq.

rows: She **believes in** giving everyone a chance.

items.text: Our clinic **specialises in** sports injuries and back problems.
items.translation: Klinikamiz sport jarohatlari va bel kasalliklari**ga ixtisoslashgan**.

items.text: Did you **succeed in** getting tickets for the final?
Kate doesn't **believe in** diets — she just eats less sugar.
items.translation: Keyt parhezlar**ga ishonmaydi** — shunchaki kamroq shakar yeydi.

blocks.text: into: break into, crash into, divide into, translate into

**into** — harakat natijasida biror narsaning **ichiga** kirish yoki unga **urilish**: **break into** a house (o'g'rilikka kirmoq), **crash / drive / bump / run / walk into** (... ga urilmoq). **bump into / run into** somebody — kutilmaganda uchratib qolmoq. Bo'lish va o'zgartirish ham **into**: **divide / cut / split** something **into** parts; **translate** a book **from** English **into** Uzbek; **turn into** (... ga aylanmoq). O'zbekchadagi `-ga` sababli «crash to», «divide on three parts», «translate to» deyiladi; British English da translate **into** — standart.

items.text: Thieves **broke into** the school last night and stole twelve computers.
items.translation: Kecha tunda o'g'rilar maktab**ga bostirib kirib**, o'n ikkita kompyuterni o'g'irlab ketishdi.

items.text: The teacher **divided** the class **into** four groups for the project.
items.translation: O'qituvchi loyiha uchun sinfni to'rt guruh**ga bo'ldi**.

items.text: His first novel has been **translated into** twenty languages.
items.translation: Uning birinchi romani yigirmata til**ga tarjima qilingan**.

blocks.text: with: collide with, fill with, provide with

**collide with** — ... bilan to'qnashmoq. **fill** something **with** — ... bilan to'ldirmoq (sifat esa **full of** → 131-dars). **provide / supply** somebody **with** something — ... ni ... bilan ta'minlamoq. Ikki qolipni qiyoslang: provide **somebody with** something = provide **something for** somebody; supply **somebody with** something = supply **something to** somebody. O'zbekchada «mehmonlar**ga** sochiq beradi» — `-ga`, shuning uchun «provide guests towels» yoki «provide to guests» xatolari uchraydi.
to: happen to, invite to, prefer ... to

**happen to** — ... ga (kishi yoki narsaga) nimadir bo'lmoq: What **happened to** your phone? **invite** somebody **to** a party / a wedding / an interview. **prefer** one thing **to** another — birini boshqasidan afzal ko'rmoq: I prefer tea **to** coffee («prefer tea than coffee» — xato; batafsil → 59-dars). Yana: belong **to**, listen **to**, explain **to** (→ 132-dars).
on: concentrate on, insist on, spend on

**concentrate on** — diqqatni ... ga jamlamoq. **insist on** + ot / -ing — turib olmoq, qat'iy talab qilmoq: He insisted **on** paying («insist to pay» — xato). **spend / waste** money or time **on** something — ... ga sarflamoq / behuda sarflamoq: spend money **on** clothes. Vaqt + -ing bilan esa predlog yo'q: spend two hours **cooking**. O'zbekchadagi «kiyim**ga** pul sarfladim» `-ga` si tufayli «spend for clothes» yoki «spend to clothes» deyiladi — to'g'risi **on**.

items.text: I can't **concentrate on** my work with all this noise from the street.
items.translation: Ko'chadan kelayotgan bu shovqinda ishim**ga diqqatimni jamlay olmayapman**.

items.text: Grandma **insisted on** cooking for all twenty guests herself.
items.translation: Buvim yigirma mehmonning hammasiga o'zi ovqat pishirish**da turib oldi**.

items.text: Last year Jasur **spent** almost all his savings **on** a new car.
items.translation: O'tgan yili Jasur deyarli barcha jamg'armasini yangi mashina**ga sarfladi**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I believe in you» (rost gapiryapsan ma'nosida) → **I believe you**; «succeed to find» → **succeed in finding**; «crash to a tree» → **crash into** a tree; «divide on three parts» → **divide into** three parts; «translate to Uzbek» → **translate into** Uzbek; «provide them food» → **provide them with** food; «full with water» → **full of** water (lekin **filled with**); «prefer tea than coffee» → **prefer tea to coffee**; «insist to pay» → **insist on paying**; «spend money for clothes» → **spend money on** clothes.

**into** = harakat bilan ichiga: crash into, break into, divide into, translate into, turn into — har birida biror narsa boshqa narsaning ichiga «kiradi» yoki unga aylanadi. **on** = bitta nuqta: concentrate on, spend on, insist on — diqqat, pul, talab bitta nishonga qaratiladi. **in** = soha ichida: believe in, specialise in, invest in.

Bog'lanish: succeed in / insist on + -ing — 62-dars; prefer ... to ... — 59-dars; full of / crowded with — 131-dars; depend on, rely on — 135-dars. Keyingi darsdan (137-dars) frazali fe'llar boshlanadi: fe'l + in / out / on / off / up — bu yerda predlog emas, ma'noni o'zgartiruvchi qism.

examples.title: **believe** or **believe in**?
examples.description: believe somebody / something — gapini rost deb bilmoq; believe in — mavjudligiga yoki g'oyaning to'g'riligiga, foydasiga ishonmoq.

sentences.text: Do you **believe in** ghosts, or do you think it's all nonsense?
sentences.translation: Arvohlar**ga ishonasizmi** yoki bularning hammasi bema'nilik deb o'ylaysizmi?

sentences.text: I didn't **believe** a word he said about his rich uncle.
sentences.translation: Uning boy amakisi haqida aytganlarining birorta so'zi**ga ham ishonmadim**.

sentences.text: Our coach really **believes in** young players and gives them a chance.
sentences.translation: Murabbiyimiz yosh o'yinchilar**ga** chindan **ishonadi** va ularga imkoniyat beradi.

sentences.text: Madina **believes in** treating everyone equally, whatever their job.
sentences.translation: Madina kasbidan qat'i nazar hammaga teng munosabatda bo'lish **tarafdori**.

sentences.text: Nobody **believed** Jasur when he said he had met a famous singer.
sentences.translation: Jasur mashhur xonanda bilan uchrashganini aytganda, hech kim unga **ishonmadi**.

sentences.text: Many people in the village still **believe in** traditional medicine.
sentences.translation: Qishloqdagi ko'p odamlar hali ham xalq tabobati**ga ishonadi**.

sentences.text: You have to **believe in** yourself if you want other people to believe in you.
sentences.translation: Boshqalar sizga ishonishini istasangiz, avvalo o'zingiz**ga ishonishingiz** kerak.

sentences.text: Should I **believe** the weather forecast? It says it'll snow in April!
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumoti**ga ishonaymi**? Aprelda qor yog'adi deyapti!

sentences.text: James doesn't **believe in** luck — he thinks success comes from hard work.
sentences.translation: Jeyms omad**ga ishonmaydi** — muvaffaqiyat mashaqqatli mehnatdan keladi, deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: I **believe** you, but the police will need more evidence.
sentences.translation: Men siz**ga ishonaman**, lekin politsiyaga ko'proq dalil kerak bo'ladi.

examples.title: **specialise in**, **succeed in**, **invest in**
examples.description: specialise in — ... ga ixtisoslashmoq; succeed in + -ing — ... ga muvaffaq bo'lmoq («succeed to do» emas); invest in — ... ga sarmoya kiritmoq.

sentences.text: Nilufar is a lawyer who **specialises in** family law.
sentences.translation: Nilufar oila huquqi**ga ixtisoslashgan** advokat.

sentences.text: After three attempts, Bekzod finally **succeeded in** passing his driving test.
sentences.translation: Uch urinishdan keyin Bekzod nihoyat haydovchilik imtihonidan o'tish**ga muvaffaq bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: This restaurant **specialises in** dishes from the Fergana Valley.
sentences.translation: Bu restoran Farg'ona vodiysi taomlari**ga ixtisoslashgan**.

sentences.text: Did the firefighters **succeed in** saving the old building?
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar eski binoni saqlab qolish**ga muvaffaq bo'lishdimi**?

sentences.text: The government plans to **invest in** solar energy over the next ten years.
sentences.translation: Hukumat keyingi o'n yil ichida quyosh energiyasi**ga sarmoya kiritishni** rejalashtirmoqda.

sentences.text: What does your company **specialise in**? — Software for small hotels.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyangiz nima**ga ixtisoslashgan**? — Kichik mehmonxonalar uchun dasturlarga.

sentences.text: We didn't **succeed in** finding a hotel, so we slept at the station.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona topish**ga muvaffaq bo'lmadik**, shuning uchun vokzalda tunadik.

sentences.text: Oliver studied medicine in Edinburgh and now **specialises in** children's heart problems.
sentences.translation: Oliver Edinburgda tibbiyot o'qigan, hozir bolalar yurak kasalliklari**ga ixtisoslashgan**.

sentences.text: It's never too late to **invest in** your own education.
sentences.translation: O'z ta'limingiz**ga sarmoya kiritish** uchun hech qachon kech emas.

sentences.text: Few start-ups **succeed in** making a profit during their first year.
sentences.translation: Birinchi yilida foyda olish**ga muvaffaq bo'ladigan** startaplar kam.

examples.title: **break into**, **crash into**, **bump into**
examples.description: into — harakat bilan ichiga kirish yoki urilish: break into (o'g'rilikka kirmoq), crash / drive / walk into (urilmoq), bump / run into somebody (tasodifan uchratib qolmoq).

sentences.text: Someone **broke into** our car and took the radio.
sentences.translation: Kimdir mashinamiz**ni buzib ochib**, radioni olib ketdi.

sentences.text: A lorry **crashed into** a bus stop on the main road this morning.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab katta yo'lda yuk mashinasi avtobus bekati**ga urilib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Guess who I **bumped into** at the dentist's? My first boss from Manchester!
sentences.translation: Tish shifokorinikida kim**ni uchratib qolganimni** top-chi? Manchesterdagi birinchi boshlig'imni!

sentences.text: Be careful not to **walk into** the glass door — it's very clean!
sentences.translation: Ehtiyot bo'ling, shisha eshik**ka urilib ketmang** — juda toza!

sentences.text: Burglars **broke into** three houses in our street while people were on holiday.
sentences.translation: Odamlar ta'tildaligida o'g'rilar ko'chamizdagi uchta uy**ga bostirib kirishdi**.

sentences.text: I **ran into** Aziz in London — I had no idea he was living there!
sentences.translation: Londonda Aziz**ni uchratib qoldim** — u yerda yashashini umuman bilmasdim!

sentences.text: The driver lost control and **drove into** a wall, but nobody was hurt.
sentences.translation: Haydovchi boshqaruvni yo'qotib, devor**ga urilib ketdi**, lekin hech kim jarohatlanmadi.

sentences.text: Hackers **broke into** the bank's computer system and stole customer data.
sentences.translation: Xakerlar bankning kompyuter tizimi**ga buzib kirishdi** va mijozlar ma'lumotlarini o'g'irlashdi.

sentences.text: Sorry, I didn't see you there — I almost **bumped into** you!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, sizni ko'rmabman — sizga **urilib ketishimga** oz qoldi!

sentences.text: What a coincidence! We **ran into** Kate and James at the airport in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Qanday tasodif! Toshkent aeroportida Keyt va Jeyms**ni uchratib qoldik**.

examples.title: **divide into**, **translate into**, **turn into**
examples.description: Bo'lish va o'zgartirish — into: divide / cut / split something into parts, translate from ... into ..., turn into (... ga aylanmoq).

sentences.text: **Cut** the melon **into** eight pieces and put it on the big plate.
sentences.translation: Qovunni sakkiz bo'lak**ka bo'ling** va katta likopchaga qo'ying.

sentences.text: The book is **divided into** three parts, each about a different city.
sentences.translation: Kitob uch qism**ga bo'lingan**, har biri boshqa shahar haqida.

sentences.text: Could you **translate** this letter **from** Uzbek **into** English for me?
sentences.translation: Bu xatni men uchun o'zbekchadan ingliz tili**ga tarjima qilib bera olasizmi**?

sentences.text: We **split into** two teams and started the game.
sentences.translation: Ikki jamoa**ga bo'linib**, o'yinni boshladik.

sentences.text: In just a few years, the old factory has **turned into** a popular art centre.
sentences.translation: Bir necha yil ichida eski zavod mashhur san'at markazi**ga aylandi**.

sentences.text: Nilufar's novel has been **translated into** six languages, including Korean.
sentences.translation: Nilufarning romani olti til**ga**, jumladan koreys tiliga ham **tarjima qilingan**.

sentences.text: Let's **divide** the money **into** three equal parts — that's the fairest way.
sentences.translation: Pulni uchta teng qism**ga bo'laylik** — eng adolatli yo'li shu.

sentences.text: When the temperature drops below zero, water **turns into** ice.
sentences.translation: Harorat noldan pastga tushganda suv muz**ga aylanadi**.

sentences.text: The manager **split** the project **into** smaller tasks so that everyone knew what to do.
sentences.translation: Hamma nima qilishni bilishi uchun menejer loyihani kichikroq vazifalar**ga ajratdi**.

sentences.text: How do you **translate** this Uzbek proverb **into** English? It's really difficult.
sentences.translation: Bu o'zbek maqolini ingliz tili**ga** qanday **tarjima qilasiz**? Juda qiyin-ku.

examples.title: **collide with**, **fill with**, **provide with**
examples.description: collide with — to'qnashmoq; fill something with — to'ldirmoq (sifat: full of); provide / supply somebody with something = provide something for somebody.

sentences.text: Two cyclists **collided with** each other at the corner of the park.
sentences.translation: Bog' burchagida ikki velosipedchi bir-biri **bilan to'qnashib ketdi**.

sentences.text: Please **fill** this bottle **with** water before we start the hike.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, yo'lga chiqishimizdan oldin bu shishaga **suv to'ldirib oling**.

sentences.text: The hotel **provides** every guest **with** a free map of the city.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona har bir mehmon**ni** bepul shahar xaritasi **bilan ta'minlaydi**.

sentences.text: The ship **collided with** a fishing boat in thick fog.
sentences.translation: Kema quyuq tumanda baliqchilar qayig'i **bilan to'qnashdi**.

sentences.text: A local farm **supplies** the school **with** fresh milk and vegetables.
sentences.translation: Mahalliy ferma maktab**ni** yangi sut va sabzavotlar **bilan ta'minlaydi**.

sentences.text: Her eyes **filled with** tears when she read her father's old letter.
sentences.translation: Otasining eski xatini o'qiganda ko'zlari yosh**ga to'ldi**.

sentences.text: Does the company **provide** you **with** a laptop, or do you use your own?
sentences.translation: Kompaniya siz**ni** noutbuk **bilan ta'minlaydimi** yoki o'zingiznikidan foydalanasizmi?

sentences.text: The charity **provides** food and blankets **for** homeless people in winter.
sentences.translation: Xayriya tashkiloti qishda uysiz odamlar**ga** oziq-ovqat va adyol **yetkazib beradi**.

sentences.text: Our flat **filled with** smoke because Jasur had forgotten the pan on the cooker.
sentences.translation: Jasur tovani plitada unutib qo'ygani uchun kvartiramiz tutun**ga to'lib ketdi**.

sentences.text: All runners will be **supplied with** water and energy bars by the organisers.
sentences.translation: Barcha yuguruvchilar tashkilotchilar tomonidan suv va energetik batonchiklar **bilan ta'minlanadi**.

examples.title: **happen to**, **invite to**, **prefer** A **to** B
examples.description: happen to — ... ga nimadir bo'lmoq; invite somebody to — ... ga taklif qilmoq; prefer one thing to another — afzal ko'rmoq («prefer ... than» emas).

sentences.text: What **happened to** your hand? — I burnt it on the oven.
sentences.translation: Qo'lingiz**ga nima bo'ldi**? — Pechda kuydirib oldim.

sentences.text: Have you been **invited to** Bekzod's wedding? — Yes, all of us have.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning to'yi**ga taklif qilindingizmi**? — Ha, hammamiz.

sentences.text: I **prefer** working from home **to** working in the office.
sentences.translation: Ofisda ishlash**dan** ko'ra uydan ishlash**ni afzal ko'raman**.

sentences.text: Whatever **happens to** the economy, people will always need doctors.
sentences.translation: Iqtisodiyot**ga nima bo'lmasin**, odamlarga doim shifokorlar kerak bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Kate **invited** us **to** her parents' farm near Oxford for the weekend.
sentences.translation: Keyt bizni dam olish kunlari Oksford yaqinidagi ota-onasining fermasi**ga taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: Most of my friends **prefer** football **to** basketball.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimning ko'pchiligi basketbol**dan** ko'ra futbol**ni afzal ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Nobody knows what **happened to** the money that was raised for the new park.
sentences.translation: Yangi bog' uchun yig'ilgan pul**ga nima bo'lganini** hech kim bilmaydi.

sentences.text: Twelve candidates were **invited to** an interview, but only one got the job.
sentences.translation: O'n ikki nomzod suhbat**ga taklif qilindi**, lekin ishga faqat bittasi olindi.

sentences.text: Do you **prefer** summer **to** winter, or do you actually like the cold?
sentences.translation: Qish**dan** ko'ra yoz**ni afzal ko'rasizmi** yoki aslida sovuqni yoqtirasizmi?

sentences.text: The same thing **happened to** me last year — my flight was cancelled at the last minute.
sentences.translation: Xuddi shu voqea o'tgan yili mening **boshimga ham tushgan** — reysim so'nggi daqiqada bekor qilindi.

examples.title: **concentrate on**, **insist on**, **spend on**
examples.description: concentrate on — diqqatni jamlamoq; insist on + -ing — turib olmoq; spend / waste money or time on — ... ga sarflamoq («spend for» emas).

sentences.text: Turn off the TV — I'm trying to **concentrate on** my homework.
sentences.translation: Televizorni o'chir — uy vazifam**ga diqqatimni jamlashga** harakat qilyapman.

sentences.text: My father **insisted on** driving us to the airport at four in the morning.
sentences.translation: Dadam bizni ertalab soat to'rtda aeroportga olib borish**da turib oldi**.

sentences.text: How much money do you **spend on** food every week?
sentences.translation: Har hafta ovqat**ga** qancha pul **sarflaysiz**?

sentences.text: The new manager wants us to **concentrate on** customers, not paperwork.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer qog'ozbozlikka emas, mijozlar**ga e'tibor qaratishimizni** istaydi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **insists on** speaking English with her children at home.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza uyda farzandlari bilan inglizcha gaplashish**da qat'iy turadi**.

sentences.text: Don't **waste** your money **on** cheap shoes — they'll fall apart in a month.
sentences.translation: Arzon poyabzal**ga** pulingizni **behuda sarflamang** — bir oyda yirtilib ketadi.

sentences.text: Teenagers **spend** a lot of time **on** their phones, according to a new study.
sentences.translation: Yangi tadqiqotga ko'ra, o'smirlar telefonlari**ga** ko'p vaqt **sarflaydi**.

sentences.text: If you **insist on** paying, at least let me buy the dessert.
sentences.translation: Agar to'lash**da turib olsangiz**, hech bo'lmasa shirinlikni menga oldiring.

sentences.text: To win at this level, athletes must **concentrate on** every single point.
sentences.translation: Bu darajada g'alaba qozonish uchun sportchilar har bir ochko**ga diqqatni jamlashi** kerak.

sentences.text: The city has **spent** millions **on** the new metro line, and it's finally open.
sentences.translation: Shahar yangi metro liniyasi**ga** millionlab **sarfladi** va nihoyat u ochildi.

examples.title: Mixed: everyday stories
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: in, into, with, to, on — bir gapda ikkita «fe'l + predlog».

sentences.text: Thieves **broke into** the office and **filled** their bags **with** laptops.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar ofis**ga bostirib kirishdi** va sumkalarini noutbuklar **bilan to'ldirishdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **believes in** saving money, so she never **spends** much **on** clothes.
sentences.translation: Madina pul tejash **tarafdori**, shuning uchun kiyim**ga** hech qachon ko'p **sarflamaydi**.

sentences.text: What **happened to** the car? — Bekzod **crashed into** a lamp post last night.
sentences.translation: Mashina**ga nima bo'ldi**? — Bekzod kecha kechqurun chiroq ustuni**ga urilib ketdi**.

sentences.text: The teacher **divided** us **into** pairs and **insisted on** speaking only English.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi bizni juftlik**larga bo'ldi** va faqat inglizcha gaplashish**ni talab qildi**.

sentences.text: If you **concentrate on** your studies, you'll **succeed in** getting a scholarship.
sentences.translation: Agar o'qishingiz**ga e'tibor qaratsangiz**, grant olish**ga muvaffaq bo'lasiz**.

sentences.text: Sarah **prefers** trains **to** planes because she can **concentrate on** her work during the journey.
sentences.translation: Sara samolyot**dan** ko'ra poyezd**ni afzal ko'radi**, chunki yo'lda ishi**ga diqqatini jamlay oladi**.

sentences.text: The company **specialises in** legal documents and can **translate** them **into** fifteen languages.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya yuridik hujjatlar**ga ixtisoslashgan** va ularni o'n besh til**ga tarjima qila oladi**.

sentences.text: When I **bumped into** Oliver, he **invited** me **to** his birthday party.
sentences.translation: Oliver**ni uchratib qolganimda**, u meni tug'ilgan kuni**ga taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: The government **provides** young families **with** cheap loans and **spends** a lot **on** housing.
sentences.translation: Hukumat yosh oilalar**ni** arzon kreditlar **bilan ta'minlaydi** va uy-joy**ga** ko'p mablag' **sarflaydi**.

sentences.text: Nobody could **believe** that such a small team had **succeeded in** winning the cup.
sentences.translation: Shunday kichik jamoa kubokni yutish**ga muvaffaq bo'lganiga** hech kim **ishona olmadi**.
